title: Combining a comparison with not
description: You can evaluate both parts of the supplied weather condition.

steps.description: You set temperature to 72 and raining to False. These values supply the two parts of the condition.

steps.question: Is temperature >= 60 and not raining True for these values?
steps.answer: Yes. 72 >= 60 is True, and not False is True, so and combines two True values.

steps.description: The True condition selects the first indented print. You take the branch with the message about going outside.
The else branch supplies the alternative when the condition is False. This run prints only the going-outside message.
